item_results.rationale: B0127 supplies all four committed elements: named closest comparators, their shared producer-checker pattern, the P33-specific owner-semantics layer, and an explicit frozen-corpus/no-firstness/no-priority bound; the original lacked this focused comparison.

B0087 materially improves retrievability with a commit locator, common access condition, exact paths, and hashes, but named artifacts such as the annotated bibliography and closed bibliography are not each furnished with the full required locator/path/version/hash/access-or-unavailable tuple.

B0107 newly makes the authority boundary and preserved claim limits explicit, but also confirms that the standalone P33-S03/P33-S16 entries, separate bibliography authorization, and complete base-plus-correction use bindings remain absent.
B0040 replaces the original numbered phase/role narration with a field-facing evidence-synthesis procedure and expressly relocates retained workflow history and checks to provenance.

B0061 adds the required actor categories, dependency classifications, and producer-code exclusion, but explicitly records the fixture oracle and implemented components as unavailable and supplies no actual fixture-oracle provenance or producer/adapter/checker build hashes.

B0057/B0059 add genuine canonical-byte, enum, registry, state, digest, and predicate rules, but B0062 still says no fixture bytes exist and B0128 expressly supplies prose traces rather than concrete valid and invalid fixture bytes.

B0051 adds hashed inputs, the CP domain/order, exact cutoff handling, stop conditions, ledger/stream accounting, and checker replay, but leaves the BP enumeration order or canonical empty-order rule and per-producer coverage-digest/termination-measure conjuncts incomplete.
B0045 identifies row-level retrieval/screening surfaces and reconciles 20 sources to 48 uses, yet expressly says every one of the 48 uses still lacks an exact passage or hypothesis locator.

B0025 supplies the control presentation, ordered generators, parameter specialization, cutoff/guard inputs, canonical artifact digests, and an explicit command that CP consume those exact values and digests.
B0070 fixes one-versus-two member cardinality, pre-derivation deduplication, canonical member ordering, self-inverse linking, deterministic owner-ID derivation, and singleton non-double-counting.

B0128 adds valid and invalid non-scientific BP/CP traces and fail-closed terminal states, but only the valid trace explicitly carries private payloads through adapter mapping and predicates; the invalid BP/CP branches omit that full required chain.
B0057 now requires exact schema-version and proof-registry-digest equality and gives every migration its own version/digest plus complete transformed-record revalidation.

B0081 correctly assumption-types both directions and bars arithmetic/Route inference, but B0007, B0020, B0082, B0100, and B0109 retain target-empty/control-nonempty reliance without the required assumption label or exact separately authorized source/proof citation.
